core_obligations: Use base-change stability of quasi-affinity and the descending-types lemma to reduce to a single flat surjective map of affines R -> A (proof lines 9460-9473).
Exhibit V -> X as a quasi-compact open immersion V -> W = Spec_X(pi_* O_V) using the characterisation of quasi-affine morphisms (proof lines 9474-9480).
Apply flat base change to identify the pullbacks of pi_* O_V with the pushforwards of V x_S X and X x_S V along the two projections (proof lines 9481-9500).

Show that the descent isomorphism phi induces an isomorphism phi^sharp of quasi-coherent sheaves of algebras whose cocycle condition is inherited from that of phi, producing a descent datum on W (proof lines 9501-9505).
Descend W using effectivity of descent for quasi-coherent algebras or the affine lemma, obtaining U' -> S, and record that U' is affine (proof lines 9506-9511).

View V as a quasi-compact open of X x_S U' stable under the canonical descent datum, descend the subset to U c U', and conclude that U is open by the fpqc quotient-topology lemma (proof lines 9513-9529).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to a single flat surjective map of affines (proof lines 9460-9473).
The open immersion into the relative spectrum of the pushforward (proof lines 9474-9480).
Flat base change and the induced algebra descent datum on W (proof lines 9481-9505).
Descend W to an affine U' (proof lines 9506-9511).
Descend the open subset and conclude openness by the quotient topology (proof lines 9513-9529).
difficulty_reason: Let an fpqc covering {X_i -> S} be given and a descent datum (V_i/X_i, phi_ij) relative to it; if each V_i -> X_i is quasi-affine, the datum is asserted to be effective (statement lines 9449-9458). The proof is long and displayed in full: quasi-affinity is base-change stable, so the descending-types lemma reduces to a single flat surjective map of affines Spec(A) -> Spec(R); the quasi-affine V -> X is then exhibited as a quasi-compact open immersion into W = Spec_X(pi_* O_V); flat base change along the two projections identifies the pullbacks of pi_* O_V with the pushforwards of the two base changes of V, so the descent isomorphism phi induces an isomorphism phi^sharp of quasi-coherent sheaves of algebras satisfying the cocycle condition, i.e. a descent datum on the affine scheme W, which is effective; the constructed U' is affine by the descending-property-affine lemma; finally V is seen as a quasi-compact open of X x_S U' stable under the canonical descent datum, so it is the inverse image of a subset U of U', and that subset is open by the fpqc quotient-topology lemma (proof lines 9460-9530). The level is H3: the card carries a genuine multi-step construction -- algebraisation of the pullbacks, effectivity of descent for the algebra W, and an open-subset descent at the end -- not a citation of a known effectivity theorem.
